english.title: Cause/permit vehicle to stand likely to cause danger to an aircraft - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on part of Liverpool John Lennon Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), when in charge of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), caused or permitted it to stand so as to have been likely to cause danger to an aircraft, person or property airside
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 5(3) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
